comparison.objective: Install a rack rail; record disinfects an IV connector hub before attaching and using a flush syringe.
comparison.physical_skill: Rigid assembly with spring insertion and fastening versus timed scrubbing, contamination-safe handling, connector attachment, and fluid delivery.
comparison.success_condition: Four-point rail retention and correct screws versus adequate scrub duration followed by correct syringe connection/flush without contamination.
comparison.reason: Connector hygiene and fluid procedure are unrelated to rack-rail installation.
